topic: Энергия активации Q и структурный множитель A ползучести солей ВКМ
routes_summary: search_hybrid ×2 (RU + 2 paraphrases; VKM-scoped) · search_text ×6 (энергия активации; activation energy EN; кДж/моль; Аррениуса; Q RT exp in FORMULA; T-test in 14 VKM creep sources) · find_parameters · find_formulas · translate_term · get_page (SRC-045, SRC-047, SRC-054, SRC-103, SRC-175)
conclusion: No Q or A for any VKM salt. Arrhenius values exist only NON_VKM (SRC-193: 42 / 54 / 24.5–25 kJ/mol; SRC-189 formulas). SRC-045 gives only the form a = A·exp(−Q/RT); SRC-103 (Палашер, Abaqus) states A, m, n are «functions of temperature» without numbers; SRC-054 p.150 gives a strength drop 300→220 kgf/cm² at 20→80 °C (deposit not named, [37]; already WPV-020746/020747) — not an activation energy. Q, A for VKM remain UNKNOWN; analogues only via explicit Transfer.

topic: Температура лабораторных испытаний на ползучесть солей ВКМ
routes_summary: search_text ×5 (комнатной температуре; постоянной температуре…; при температуре 20 °С…; T −8/−12/+10 in SRC-103; температура in SKRU-1 sources) · search_hybrid (VKM scope, T formulation) · find_tables (SRC-103) · get_page (SRC-092, SRC-054, SRC-103) · get_page_image (SRC-103 p.53)
conclusion: Only two temperature statements exist and both are already in the passport: SRC-103 (Палашерский участок ВКМКС) prescribes stepwise creep tests at +10, −8 and −12 °C (WPV-022935/022936 — mis-scoped there as NON_VKM; re-scoped in RA-001), and SRC-054 cites 16–20 °C room temperature for sylvinite creep (Stavrogin [119], Starobin context; WPV-022938). The test temperature of the main VKM creep datasets (SRC-044, SRC-025/202, SRC-047, SRC-092 for СКРУ-1) is NOT stated anywhere → stays UNKNOWN (THM-039 confirmed). C4-061 «20 °C» is an EXTERNAL source (Selikhov 2026), not corpus.

topic: Параметры функции влияния (Кноте r/tgβ, Авершин, радиус влияния, интеграционные палетки)
routes_summary: search_text ×6 (функция влияния VKM-scoped; Кноте Knothe; палетки Кутовой Катаев; интеграционные палетки… in 5 sources; Авершина; EN influence function radius tanβ) + 1 AND-combination · search_hybrid (2 paraphrases) · find_formulas · translate_term · get_page (SRC-065 p.133, p.164)
conclusion: No spatial influence-function parameter (Knothe r, tanβ, Avershin, radius of influence) for VKM. At VKM «функция влияния» means the hereditary time kernel (SRC-044 eq.6.10, SRC-203, SRC-122). Sharpened: SRC-065 p.164 states that the integration grids of Kutovoy/Kataev [33, 40] use the angular parameters and dimensionless distributions of the «Указания» [19] — i.e. no independent parameter set exists. Knothe/B = h·tanβ only in NON_VKM (Hejmanowski, SaltMechX caverns, Sidkirius potash) and textbooks.

topic: Параметры закона поврежденности солей/целиков ВКМ (Lω, p*, σu*; Качанов–Работнов)
routes_summary: search_text ×2 (поврежденность VKM-scoped; Качанова Работнова) · find_formulas · search_hybrid (2 paraphrases) · get_page (SRC-047 p.161–162; SRC-103 p.61–62) · get_page_image ×3 · catalogue grep (passport DAMAGE_PARAM, MR-IDC, MM-DAMAGE)
conclusion: WORLD0 GAPS «чисел нет» is wrong: SRC-047 pp.161–162 print the full parameter set of the damage law (5.83c) for rock salt and sylvinite (p*, σu*, σs0, Dy, mω — partly in passport; Lω0 and Lp — new), fitted to ≈20-min creep/relaxation tests (LAB). Also known: SRC-044 eqs 4.31–4.35 creep-damage constants (WPV-016821…016825) and SRC-197 D(t) with conditionally assumed α, λ. No Kachanov–Rabotnov law applied to VKM.
